newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan foreign trade deficit widens to $187 mln.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan foreign trade deficit widens to $187 mln.

text.p: Moldova's foreign trade deficit widened to $187 million in January-August of this year from $24 million in the same period last year, a report from the State Statistics Department said on Thursday.
It said that imports in the first eight months of this year grew by 42 percent to $694 million, while exports increased by 23 percent to $507 million.
Countries of the Commonwealth of Independent States accounted for 70 percent of Moldovan exports and 61 percent of imports. Russia alone accounted for 55 percent of exports and 28 percent of imports.
